arxiv-2101-04128.title: X-ray Spectra and Multiwavelength Machine Learning Classification for Likely Counterparts to Fermi 3FGL Unassociated Sources Journal: AJ
arxiv-2101-04128.creator: Stephen Kerby, Amanpreet Kaur, Abraham D. Falcone, Michael C. Stroh, Elizabeth C. Ferrara, Jamie A. Kennea, Joseph Colosimo
arxiv-2101-04128.description: Abstract We conduct X-ray spectral fits on 184 likely counterparts to Fermi -LAT 3FGL unassociated sources. Characterization and classification of these sources allows for more complete population studies of the high-energy sky. Most of these X-ray spectra are well fit by an absorbed power law model, as expected for a population dominated by blazars and pulsars.

arxiv-2201-06846.description: Abstract . A code 𝒞 ⊆ { 0 , 1 , 2 } n \mathcal{C}\subseteq\{0,1,2\}^{n} is said to be trifferent with length n n when for any three distinct elements of 𝒞 \mathcal{C} there exists a coordinate in which they all differ.

arxiv-2211-05871.title: On the Ramifications of Human Label Uncertainty
arxiv-2211-05871.creator: Chen Zhou, Mohit Prabhushankar, Ghassan AlRegib
arxiv-2211-05871.description: Abstract Humans exhibit disagreement during data labeling. We term this disagreement as human label uncertainty . In this work, we study the ramifications of human label uncertainty (HLU). Our evaluation of existing uncertainty estimation algorithms, with the presence of HLU, indicates the limitations of existing uncertainty metrics and algorithms themselves in response to HLU.

arxiv-2411-08041.title: GraphAide: Advanced Graph-Assisted Query and Reasoning System
arxiv-2411-08041.creator: Sumit Purohit, George Chin, Patrick S Mackey, Joseph A Cottam
arxiv-2411-08041.description: Abstract Curating knowledge from multiple siloed sources that contain both structured and unstructured data is a major challenge in many real-world applications. Pattern matching and querying represent fundamental tasks in modern data analytics that leverage this curated knowledge. The development of such applications necessitates overcoming several research challenges, including data extraction, named entity recognition, data modeling, and designing query interfaces.
